top_stories.title: tribuneindia...Spotlight
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Dasarat Prasad**, the **Manipur Tourism Director**, was shot and killed by two assailants at his office in Imphal. The motive behind the killing remains unclear, but an Assistant Director of the Tourism Department narrowly escaped being harmed.  The Delhi High Court dismissed petitions seeking an independent probe into a 1994 contract awarded to a consortium of companies. The court also ordered the **Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)** to make answer sheets available to students if needed, emphasizing transparency in their evaluation policy. President K.R. Narayanan expressed condolences for the death of former Lok Sabha Deputy Speaker G.G. Swell, who died in Shillong today.

top_stories.title: Centre directs fuel companies to build 30-day LPG strategic reserves amid Hormuz disruption
top_stories.rephrased_article: **India's** **Petroleum Ministry** has instructed public sector oil marketing companies (OMCs) to increase LPG reserves to at least 30 days of demand, beyond their regular commercial stocks.  The move comes as the ongoing West Asia conflict has disrupted fuel supply and led to a near-closure of the Strait of Hormuz, which is crucial for India's LPG imports. **India** currently relies on imports for about 60% of its LPG consumption, with most coming through the Strait of Hormuz. The government has implemented demand management measures to prioritize household needs and address supply shortages.

top_stories.title: Italian PM Giorgia Meloni warns her staff that 2026 will be "much worse" than 2025 - The Tribune
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Giorgia Meloni**, the Italian Prime Minister, warned her staff that 2026 will be "much worse" than 2025 due to economic challenges and global uncertainties.  She acknowledged their hard work during the year and advised them to rest during the holidays. **Antonio Tajani**, the Italian Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister, confirmed a planned visit by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** to Italy in 2026, highlighting discussions on strengthening India-Italy relations and cooperation on issues like peace and trade.

top_stories.title: Trump on Iran promise to not attack neighbours | Iran’s ‘surrender’ to its neighbours is because it is being ‘beat to HELL’, says Donald Trump - Telegraph India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump** claimed **Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian**'s statement on suspending attacks against neighboring countries was a result of US-Israeli aggression.  **Trump** asserted that Iran had apologized and surrendered to its Middle Eastern neighbors due to these attacks, calling it the first time Iran has ever lost to surrounding countries. **Pezeshkian**, in his televised address, rejected the US demand for unconditional surrender, apologizing for Iran's attacks on regional countries and promising to halt them.

top_stories.title: 5 Arrested For Attack On Trinamool Congress TMC Leader Abhishek Banerjee In West Bengal
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, **Trinamool Congress** leader, was attacked with stones and eggs while visiting post-poll violence victims in Sonarpur, West Bengal.  Five people have been arrested based on video footage of the incident, which occurred during his visit to the area. The police registered a case suo motu as no formal complaint was filed by Banerjee or the **Trinamool Congress**.  **Mamata Banerjee**, leader of the **Trinamool Congress**, accused the BJP of orchestrating the attack and demanded justice.

top_stories.title: 9 Midcap stocks with massive upside potential of up to 45%! Do you own any? - Upside scope | The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Trendlyne**, a data analysis platform, has identified nine mid-cap stocks with potential for strong returns over the next year.  Based on analyst consensus estimates, these companies are projected to experience an average upside of 25% to 45%. **Swiggy**, **Coromandel**, **Patanjali Foods**, **Info Edge**, **Prestige Estates**, **Godrej Properties**, **Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation**, **Jubilant FoodWorks**, and **Havells** are among the stocks highlighted.  These companies have an average analyst target price that suggests a potential upside of 25% to 45%.

top_stories.title: Karnataka senior leaders oppose appointing young MLAs as deputy CMs
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Senior Congress leaders**, including G Parameshwara, M B Patil, and Ramalinga Reddy, have expressed opposition to the appointment of young legislators as deputy chief ministers in the new **Karnataka** government. They met with **Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge** and AICC general secretary (organisation) K C Venugopal to convey their concerns, stating they would prefer to stay out of the government if younger leaders are appointed.  The **Congress high command** is considering appointing three deputy chief ministers representing different communities.

top_stories.title: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Sarma To Expand Cabinet On June 5, 9 MLAs Likely To Be Inducted
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, the Assam Chief Minister, announced that his cabinet will be expanded on June 5th. The expansion is expected to include eight to nine MLAs as Cabinet Ministers and two Ministers of State.  Political observers anticipate a mix of experienced leaders and new entrants from the BJP and its alliance partners. **Narendra Modi**, the Prime Minister, was among the senior leaders who attended Sarma's swearing-in ceremony on May 12th.

top_stories.title: Graham Platner Maine Senate race hit by sexting claims raised by wife and aides - India Today
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Graham Platner**, a Democrat running for US Senate in Maine, has faced scrutiny over sexually explicit messages he exchanged with several women. **Amy Gertner**, his wife, revealed to campaign officials that he had been sexting with at least 12 women outside their marriage. The revelations emerged during the campaign's internal vetting process and have raised concerns about Platner's candidacy, potentially impacting Democratic hopes of gaining control of the Senate in November.

top_stories.title: "You Did Wrong": Mamata Banerjee Heard Scolding Hospital CEO, BJP Shares Video
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, former chief minister of West Bengal, was heard scolding the CEO of Belle Vue Hospital in Kolkata after her nephew, **Abhishek Banerjee**, a Lok Sabha MP and her nephew, was attacked by a crowd.  A state BJP leader shared a clip of the incident alleging that **Banerjee** attempted to pressure the hospital to admit her nephew despite his reports showing no significant injuries. The BJP has denied any involvement in the attack, while **Banerjee** claimed that the BJP was pressuring the hospital against admitting her nephew.
